en.headline: ICAC charges HKU associate professor and three others over HK$2.2 m IT education bribes
en.dek: Gary Wong Ka-wai is accused of accepting cash rewards for awarding more than HK$10 million in purchase orders; the case is due for mention on Monday.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption charged an associate professor at the University of Hong Kong and three others on Thursday with offences linked to alleged bribes totalling about HK$2.2 million for information-technology education projects aimed at primary and secondary schools.

According to the ICAC, Gary Wong Ka-wai, 45, of the Faculty of Education and formerly director of the Centre for Information Technology in Education, faces nine counts of conspiracy for a public servant to accept advantages. Huen Man-ho, 56, sole director and shareholder of two education-service companies, faces the same conspiracy counts. Wong, Huen, Huen’s wife Joel Chu Wai-yi, 57, and Huen’s nephew Cheung Chun, 26, also face two counts of fraud relating to alleged false claims for research services that the ICAC says were never provided.

The commission said the alleged offences occurred between August 2023 and June 2026. It stated that Wong and Huen had agreed Wong would receive between 10 and 50 per cent of the value of purchase orders once they were awarded, and that the seven orders in question exceeded HK$10 million in total. The projects included a virtual-reality e-learning platform for primary schools and a Jockey Club-funded technology initiative for senior secondary students.

All four defendants were released on bail. The case is scheduled for mention at the Eastern Magistrates’ Courts on 24 August, when the prosecution is expected to apply for transfer to the District Court for plea. The ICAC said the investigation arose from a corruption complaint and that the university and the centre fully cooperated.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴港大副教授等四人 涉收賄220萬批出千萬IT教育項目
zh.dek: 黃家偉被指收受現金賄款後批出逾1000萬元採購訂單，案件下周一東區裁判法院提堂。
body: 廉政公署周四落案起訴香港大學一名副教授及另外三人，指他們涉嫌與中小學資訊科技教育項目有關的賄款及欺詐，涉款約220萬元。
廉署表示，45歲港大教育學院副教授黃家偉被控九項串謀使公職人員接受利益罪；56歲兩間教育服務公司唯一董事兼股東禤文浩同被控相同串謀罪。黃家偉、禤文浩、禤文浩57歲妻子朱慧兒及26歲姪兒張進另被控兩項欺詐罪，指四人涉嫌虛假向港大表示朱慧兒及張進曾提供研究服務，誘使港大支付共12萬元服務費，惟調查顯示兩人從未提供有關服務。
廉署指涉嫌罪行於2023年8月至2026年6月期間發生。調查發現黃家偉與禤文浩曾協議，黃家偉在項目訂單批出後可獲取訂單款額一成至五成作報酬，涉案七份採購訂單總值逾1000萬元。相關項目包括小學虛擬實境電子學習平台「eLEARN2.0」及賽馬會資助的高中科技培育計劃。
四人獲准保釋，案件下周一（8月24日）在東區裁判法院提堂，控方將申請轉介至區域法院答辯。廉署指調查源於貪污投訴，港大及相關中心在調查期間全面配合。
